name: paper-to-research-gif
description: Turn a research paper into a source-grounded, five-second animated research GIF.

interface.longDescription: Read a paper, select its central mechanism, and make a clear 4–6 second silent GIF that communicates the research at a glance. Keep claims tied to the source, label conceptual animation, and check readability, timing, looping, and file size.
defaultPrompt: Make a five-second looping GIF that explains the core idea of this paper at a glance.
Create a source-faithful research teaser GIF from this paper.

publication.release_notes: Initial skill release with research micro-story guidance and GIF encoding checks.
